title: cephalostigma perotifolium
intro: Cephalostigma perotifolium, commonly known as 'Lungwort', is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephalostigma perotifolium are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe sore throats, and promote the discharge of mucus, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory ailments. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
